title: Conversations
subtitle: Videography & Editing — Music Video
description: A music video shot and edited through Auckland City at night — handheld, grainy, and vintage. A dreamy old-school aesthetic brought to life through filmmaking and After Effects.

meta.label: By
meta.value: Branden Hall, Varish Nair, Denzel Pereiea

sections.label: Overview
paragraphs: My friends wanted me to shoot and edit their music video. They gave me some inspiration and a theme they were going for. Although informal, this project showcases my videography and editing skills in a real creative context.

The theme they wanted was a dreamy, vintage aesthetic — handheld footage with a grainy filter. That "Old Skool" vibe of a music video. We took to the streets of Auckland City at night and captured the scenes as we roamed.

sections.label: Filming
paragraphs: I independently filmed each scene for this music video. We knew we wanted it to take place within the city — Auckland at night gave us the atmosphere we needed. Most scenes were improvised on the spot as we moved through the streets.

sections.label: Editing & VFX
paragraphs: Several After Effects VFX shots were used throughout the video — including a VHS intro and outro effect with cinemascope bars, and a climax sequence where camera motion tracks between the two artists going bar for bar. This was the one planned scene in the whole video.

sections.label: Reflection
paragraphs: Since this was one of my first proper uses of After Effects and videography skills together, looking back I feel like I could've spent a bit more time on the edit and pushed the VFX further. My skills have grown a lot since 2023 — but this project was a solid foundation and a real-world test of what I'd been learning.
